title: BuildBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Compiling Real-World Open-Source Software
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Deep Learning for Code Workshop (DL4C), Poster
authors_zh: Zehua Zhang, Ati Priya Bajaj, Divij Handa, Siyu Liu, Arvind S Raj, Hongkai Chen, Hulin Wang, Yibo Liu, Zion Leonahenahe Basque, Souradip Nath, Vishal Juneja, Nikhil Chapre, Yan Shoshitaishvili, Adam Doupé, Chitta Baral, Ruoyu Wang
paper_type_zh: 环境型仓库编译智能体评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究软件工程 agent、可执行环境反馈、terminal predicate、benchmark replay 与发布审计的读者
one_line: BuildBench turns real C/C++ repositories into executable build-agent tasks with README/web retrieval, iterative shell feedback, and strict/flexible target-binary checks; the current release retains 385 candidate labels but not full rollouts or a pinned public scaffold.
BuildBench 在全新 Ubuntu 22.04 容器中以文档检索、迭代 Bash 执行反馈和目标二进制文件名 predicate 评测 C/C++ 仓库编译 agent；当前发布保留 385 个候选标签，但不含完整 command-observation rollout。
why: It cleanly separates a repository task, an interactive execution episode, and a terminal verifier, while exposing how mutable dependencies, source patching, filename-only success, missing failure traces, and release drift can undermine reuse of environment-agent data.
inclusion_reason: BuildBench makes repository compilation an environment-grounded agent episode: a model retrieves documentation, emits shell-command batches, observes build errors, and is scored by expert-targeted binary predicates. Its unusually explicit terminal contract and released positive/negative task labels are valuable, while the absence of public rollouts, code, environment locks, and complete rights/security metadata is itself an important audit boundary.

title: Problem
问题
html:
BuildBench asks whether an LLM agent can compile real C/C++ repositories when success depends on interacting with a changing software environment rather than emitting a static answer. The primary paper record is arXiv:2509.25248v1, submitted on 2025-09-27. The official NeurIPS page identifies it as a poster at the NeurIPS 2025 Deep Learning for Code in the Agentic Era (DL4C) workshop and links OpenReview note ZqFdnJLXHP; it is not a NeurIPS main-conference paper.

The evaluation task is a pinned GitHub repository plus README and root-file-list context, an Ubuntu 22.04 container, optional repository/web documentation, and expert labels for whether the repository is compilable and which executable filenames should be produced. During an evaluated episode, the agent emits Bash command batches, observes execution results and compilation errors, may install dependencies or patch source, and iterates until an undisclosed online success function fires or an undisclosed maximum turn count is reached. The episode is scored by completion and target-binary filename predicates.

This task/environment/terminal-outcome structure places the work in environment_agent_trajectory_data. The neighboring object it does not provide is a public trajectory-training corpus: the current test release has 385 repository-metadata rows and 385 manual-label rows—148 compilable and 237 non-compilable—plus 130 documentation-retrieval label records; the validation release has 70 rows. The field called “Build Trajectory” is a chain of documentation URLs, not a command-observation rollout. Complete commands, observations, patches, binaries, retry histories, and per-run verdicts are not released.

The paper evaluates agents on the 148 human-verified compilable repositories and uses a separately selected 70-repository validation set for method development. The retained 237 negative candidate labels make construction failures partially auditable, but they do not substitute for failed agent episodes. The paper and pinned data revisions support a detailed account of the benchmark object, construction process, environment, terminal predicates, results, and release drift. Canonical metadata nevertheless remains L3_summary_ready; this Card does not upgrade the accepted curation level while the public scaffold, executable evaluator, environment locks, rollout logs, rights manifest, security policy, and paper-to-release changelog remain missing.

BuildBench 研究的问题是：当成功依赖与不断变化的软件环境交互，而不是输出静态答案时，LLM agent 能否编译真实 C/C++ repository。论文主要记录为 2025 年 9 月 27 日提交的 arXiv:2509.25248v1。NeurIPS 官方页面将其标为 NeurIPS 2025 Deep Learning for Code in the Agentic Era (DL4C) workshop poster，并链接 OpenReview note ZqFdnJLXHP；它不是 NeurIPS main-conference paper。

evaluation task 由固定的 GitHub repository、README 与根目录文件列表上下文、Ubuntu 22.04 container、可选的 repository/web documentation，以及人工给出的 compilability 与目标 executable filename 标签组成。在评测 episode 中，agent 生成 Bash command batch，观察 execution result 与 compilation error，可以安装 dependency 或修改 source，并持续迭代，直到未披露的 online success function 触发或达到未披露的最大 turn 数。episode 最后由 completion 与 target-binary filename predicate 评分。

这种 task/environment/terminal-outcome 结构使论文归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data。但它没有提供相邻的数据对象——公开 trajectory-training corpus。当前 test release 包含 385 条 repository metadata 和 385 条 manual label，其中 148 条可编译、237 条不可编译，另有 130 条 documentation-retrieval label；validation release 有 70 条记录。名为“Build Trajectory”的字段是一条 documentation URL chain，而非 command-observation rollout。完整 command、observation、patch、binary、retry history 与逐 run verdict 都未发布。

论文只在 148 个经过人工确认可编译的 repository 上评测 agent，并使用另行选取的 70-repository validation set 开发方法。保留的 237 个 negative candidate label 让部分构造失败可审计，但不能替代 failed agent episode。论文与两个固定 data revision 足以支持对 benchmark object、construction process、environment、terminal predicate、result 与 release drift 的深入说明；canonical metadata 仍保持 L3_summary_ready。在 public scaffold、executable evaluator、environment lock、rollout log、rights manifest、security policy 与 paper-to-release changelog 缺失时，本 Card 不升级 accepted curation level。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
BuildBench's contribution is to turn repository compilation into an environment-grounded agent evaluation with human-verified targets, iterative execution feedback, and explicit filename-based terminal metrics.

The benchmark object has two layers. The released task/label layer records repository identity and metadata, compilability, target or cross-compiled executable filenames, documentation-URL trajectories, failure notes, comments, and—in the current test revision—a source commit hash. The evaluated episode layer begins from the repository, README/file tree, and optional retrieved instructions; a Bash Command Generator emits a command sequence S_k, an Execution Agent runs it in the container, and execution result f_k becomes the next observation. The public release does not serialize this second layer as a complete rollout corpus.

The feedback contract is mixed programmatic/environmental and attaches to the answer artifact and full episode. Online interaction stops when the undisclosed Success(f_k) is true or k reaches the undisclosed limit K. Offline Completion requires error-free termination and at least one binary; Strict Success requires every expert-listed binary filename; Flexible Success requires at least one listed filename. This contract can observe process termination, binary presence, and filename agreement. It cannot establish executable functionality, semantic preservation after patches, security, deterministic rebuildability, or whether the intended program—not a stale, intermediate, vendored, or submodule binary—was produced.

The closest stated comparison is the 100-project CompileAgentBench/CompileAgent line. BuildBench instead begins from a large GitHub C/C++ population, applies keyword/star/fork filtering, randomly samples 385 candidates, and has systems graduate students attempt every build before retaining 148 positives for agent evaluation. Its OSS-Build-Agent also combines README-first file/web retrieval with batched command generation and iterative error repair. These are benchmark-design and scaffold differences, not evidence of a new training objective.

For reasoning-data research, the directional value is the separation of task provenance, interactive state/action/observation behavior, and an episode-level terminal predicate. The release simultaneously demonstrates an audit boundary: task labels and documentation paths can support evaluation construction, but without command-observation traces, environment snapshots, and evaluator code they must not be reclassified as agent-training trajectories.

BuildBench 的贡献是把 repository compilation 转化为一种 environment-grounded agent evaluation：任务带有人工核验的目标，agent 接收迭代 execution feedback，最终由明确的 filename-based terminal metric 评分。

benchmark object 有两层。公开的 task/label 层记录 repository identity 与 metadata、compilability、target 或 cross-compiled executable filename、documentation-URL trajectory、failure note、comment，以及当前 test revision 新增的 source commit hash。评测 episode 层从 repository、README/file tree 与可选的 retrieved instruction 开始；Bash Command Generator 生成 command sequence S_k，Execution Agent 在 container 中执行，execution result f_k 成为下一步 observation。公开 release 没有把第二层序列化为完整 rollout corpus。

feedback contract 是 mixed programmatic/environmental feedback，监督附着在 answer artifact 与 full episode 上。online interaction 在未披露的 Success(f_k) 为 true 或 k 达到未披露上限 K 时停止。offline Completion 要求无错误终止且至少产生一个 binary；Strict Success 要求出现全部人工目标 binary filename；Flexible Success 要求至少出现一个目标 filename。这套 contract 能观察 process termination、binary presence 与 filename agreement，却不能确认 executable functionality、patch 后的 semantic preservation、security、deterministic rebuildability，也不能确认生成的是预期程序，而非 stale、intermediate、vendored 或 submodule binary。

论文明确给出的最近比较对象是 100-project CompileAgentBench/CompileAgent 路线。BuildBench 从大规模 GitHub C/C++ population 出发，经过 keyword/star/fork filtering 后随机抽取 385 个 candidate，再由 systems graduate student 逐个尝试 build，最后保留 148 个 positive task 用于 agent evaluation。OSS-Build-Agent 还把 README-first file/web retrieval、batched command generation 与 iterative error repair 组合起来。这些是 benchmark design 与 scaffold 的差别，不是新 training objective 的证据。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，它的方向价值是把 task provenance、interactive state/action/observation behavior 与 episode-level terminal predicate 分开。release 也同时揭示了审计边界：task label 与 documentation path 可以支持 evaluation construction，但在缺少 command-observation trace、environment snapshot 与 evaluator code 时，不能把它们重新归类为 agent-training trajectory。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and task construction. The authors query a population of 2.77 million C and 4.23 million C++ GitHub repositories dated from 2008-04-01 through 2024-01-01. They remove repositories whose names/descriptions match low-quality keywords, have fewer than 50 stars, or are forks, leaving 6.57 million. A random sample of 385 is chosen under the authors' 95% confidence/5% error rationale. Twelve systems graduate students with more than three years of reported systems-research experience spend about 150 hours attempting all candidates. They exclude wrong or non-cross-compilable OS targets, trivial/unbuildable content, missing critical files or unresolvable dependencies, and compile/link failures unresolved under best effort. This yields 148 compilable evaluation tasks. A separate set of 70 popular repositories is used for validation; the exact human best-effort time/action threshold is not operationalized.

Episode setup and retrieval. Each repository starts in a fresh Ubuntu 22.04 Docker container with root access and minimal pre-installed packages. The agent receives the repository, README, and root file list. The optional LLM-assisted retriever first distills the README, judges whether instructions are sufficient, follows up to three new repository or external-documentation links per iteration, fetches and summarizes them, and repeats for at most three iterations. Live documents, package indexes, submodules, and caches are not pinned.

Interaction loop. A Bash Command Generator produces a batch S_k; the Execution Agent runs it and returns result f_k, including build errors, for observation-driven revision. Actions can navigate directories, install dependencies, configure a debug build, compile/install or copy artifacts, retry, and modify source. Appendix D documents replacing obsolete OpenCV constants before a successful build, so source patching is part of the demonstrated behavior. The loop stops at Success(f_k) or maximum step K, but neither the implementation of Success nor numeric K is disclosed. Offline scoring then computes unvalidated Completion, Strict Success, and Flexible Success from termination, binary presence, and expert target filenames.

Models and budgets. Single-turn baselines use GPT o3-mini and Claude 3.7 Sonnet. OSS-Build-Agent is evaluated with GPT-4o, GPT o3-mini, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3 235B, and Qwen3 Coder 485B; CompileAgent uses GPT-4o. Exact API snapshot IDs, temperature, seeds, token/cost limits, wall-clock timeout, and numerical turn cap are unknown. Most configurations use one dataset-wide run. GPT-4o with retrieval is repeated three times and reported through both mean/standard deviation and pass@1–pass@3. OSS-Build-Agent averages 6.6 error-resolution attempts; CompileAgent's reported 7.5 steps use a different, one-command-at-a-time action unit.

Outputs and release. The current pinned test revision exposes 385 metadata rows, 385 repository-level labels (148 Yes, 237 No), and 130 retrieval-label objects. Test labels include commit_hash for all 385 rows. The pinned validation revision exposes 70 rows (65 Yes, 5 No) but no repository commit hash. Neither release contains full command histories, stdout/stderr logs, state snapshots, patches, binaries, per-run terminal reports, or trajectory values. There are no step-level correctness labels or state-action rewards.

Use and reproducibility boundary. The paper reports evaluation and failure analysis only; it does not report SFT, preference optimization, reward-model training, process supervision, RLVR, or agent policy training. Reproduction must pin the arXiv version, both Hugging Face revisions, each source commit, container image/Dockerfile, dependency and package-index snapshots, submodules, documentation snapshots, network and cache policy, timeout and K, model snapshots, seeds, command logs, patches, binaries, and evaluator version. No public paper-linked OSS-Build-Agent repository was verified, so artifacts.code correctly remains null. Fork removal and date/star filters are selection controls, not a model-corpus or benchmark-overlap decontamination procedure.

输入与 task construction。 作者从 2008 年 4 月 1 日至 2024 年 1 月 1 日的 277 万个 C 与 423 万个 C++ GitHub repository population 出发，删除名称/描述命中低质量 keyword、star 少于 50 或属于 fork 的 repository，余下 657 万个。随后按作者所述的 95% confidence/5% error 理由随机抽取 385 个 candidate。12 名据称拥有 3 年以上 systems research 经验的研究生耗时约 150 小时尝试全部 candidate。错误或不可 cross-compile 的 OS target、trivial/unbuildable content、缺少关键文件或 dependency 无法解析，以及在 best effort 下仍无法解决的 compile/link failure 会被排除，最终得到 148 个可编译 evaluation task。另有 70 个 popular repository 作为 validation set；人工 best-effort 的准确时间/action 阈值没有操作化定义。

Episode setup 与 retrieval。 每个 repository 都在一个全新的 Ubuntu 22.04 Docker container 中开始，agent 拥有 root 权限，环境仅预装少量 package。agent 接收 repository、README 与根目录文件列表。可选的 LLM-assisted retriever 先提炼 README，判断 instruction 是否充分；每个 iteration 最多继续访问 3 个新的 repository 或 external-documentation link，抓取并总结内容，最多重复 3 个 iteration。live document、package index、submodule 与 cache 均未固定。

Interaction loop。 Bash Command Generator 生成一批 S_k；Execution Agent 运行它并返回 result f_k，其中包括 build error，用于基于 observation 的下一轮修改。action 可以切换目录、安装 dependency、配置 debug build、compile/install 或复制 artifact、retry，以及修改 source。Appendix D 记录了 agent 替换过时 OpenCV constant 后成功 build 的案例，因此 source patching 属于实际展示的 behavior。loop 在 Success(f_k) 触发或达到最大 step K 时停止，但 Success 的实现与 K 的数值都未披露。offline scoring 再依据 termination、binary presence 与人工 target filename 计算 unvalidated Completion、Strict Success 与 Flexible Success。

Model 与预算。 single-turn baseline 使用 GPT o3-mini 和 Claude 3.7 Sonnet。OSS-Build-Agent 评测 GPT-4o、GPT o3-mini、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3 235B 与 Qwen3 Coder 485B；CompileAgent 使用 GPT-4o。准确 API snapshot ID、temperature、seed、token/cost limit、wall-clock timeout 与 turn cap 数值均为 unknown。多数 configuration 只有一次 dataset-wide run；GPT-4o with retrieval 重复 3 次，并同时报告 mean/standard deviation 与 pass@1–pass@3。OSS-Build-Agent 平均有 6.6 次 error-resolution attempt；CompileAgent 的 7.5 step 使用不同的 one-command-at-a-time action unit。

输出与 release。 当前固定的 test revision 暴露 385 条 metadata、385 条 repository-level label（148 条 Yes、237 条 No）以及 130 个 retrieval-label object；test label 为全部 385 条记录提供 commit_hash。固定的 validation revision 暴露 70 条记录（65 条 Yes、5 条 No），但没有 repository commit hash。两个 release 都不包含完整 command history、stdout/stderr log、state snapshot、patch、binary、逐 run terminal report 或 trajectory value，也没有 step-level correctness label 或 state-action reward。

用途与 reproducibility 边界。 论文只报告 evaluation 与 failure analysis，没有报告 SFT、preference optimization、reward-model training、process supervision、RLVR 或 agent policy training。复现必须固定 arXiv version、两个 Hugging Face revision、每个 source commit、container image/Dockerfile、dependency 与 package-index snapshot、submodule、documentation snapshot、network/cache policy、timeout 与 K、model snapshot、seed、command log、patch、binary 与 evaluator version。没有核验到公开且与论文关联的 OSS-Build-Agent repository，因此 artifacts.code 正确保持 null。去除 fork 与 date/star filter 只是 selection control，不是 model-corpus 或 benchmark-overlap decontamination procedure。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main paper result is reported on the 148 human-verified compilable test repositories. OSS-Build-Agent with LLM-assisted retrieval and Claude 3.7 Sonnet reaches 85.2% unvalidated Completion, 66.4% Strict Success, and 71.8% Flexible Success (Table 1). The same-model Claude 3.7 Sonnet single-turn baseline reaches 21.5% strict and 22.1% flexible, a 49.7 percentage-point strict difference. This supports the claim that the evaluated retrieval-plus-iterative-execution scaffold outperforms the paper's single-turn baseline under BuildBench's filename metrics; it does not show that released records are suitable training data.

Repeated GPT-4o retrieval runs expose instability rather than a single deterministic score. Across three runs, strict success is 53.0% ± 6.8 and flexible success is 57.6% ± 6.5; pass@3 rises to 65.5% strict and 70.3% flexible (Table 2 and Figure 4). These results show that multi-turn retrieval and execution paths vary materially. They also make run IDs, seeds, documentation snapshots, model snapshots, cache state, and full trajectories necessary for replay, yet those artifacts are not released.

On the 130 test repositories with URL-level retrieval labels, the GPT-4o OSS-Build-Agent retriever accesses the ground-truth documentation URL for 73.8%, versus 46.2% for CompileAgent (Section 6.2). This is a navigation predicate over labeled URLs, not proof that the retrieved content is correct, stable, sufficient, or license-compatible. The reported 6.6 OSS-Build-Agent error-resolution attempts and 7.5 CompileAgent steps should not be treated as identical efficiency units because the latter operates one command at a time.

The failure analysis provides a negative result: in the inspected o3-mini plus retrieval condition, 69 repositories have errors the agent recognizes but does not fix before termination (Section 6.3 and Figure 5). Appendix examples include using CMake from the wrong directory and failing to address a root-cause submodule ownership error before a downstream make install failure. These cases support brittleness in diagnosis and recovery, but complete per-run logs are unavailable for independent recoding.

The current official data artifacts add release evidence beyond the paper: 385 candidate labels retain 148 positives and 237 negatives, the test labels now pin all 385 source commits, the validation release contains 70 rows, and the retrieval JSON contains 130 records. However, only 126 of the 237 negative test rows have a non-empty failure reason, and none of these repository labels is a failed agent rollout. All performance values above are author-reported and have not been independently reproduced in this Card. Benchmark performance is evidence about systems under this benchmark contract, not evidence that the data release is complete, uncontaminated, secure, or high quality for training.

论文主要结果在 148 个经过人工核验可编译的 test repository 上报告。使用 LLM-assisted retrieval 与 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 的 OSS-Build-Agent 达到 85.2% unvalidated Completion、66.4% Strict Success 与 71.8% Flexible Success（Table 1）。使用相同 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 的 single-turn baseline 为 21.5% strict、22.1% flexible，strict 相差 49.7 个百分点。这支持“在 BuildBench filename metric 下，所评测的 retrieval-plus-iterative-execution scaffold 优于论文 single-turn baseline”，但不能证明公开记录适合作为 training data。

重复 GPT-4o retrieval run 暴露的是不稳定性，而非一个确定性 score。3 次运行的 strict success 为 53.0% ± 6.8，flexible success 为 57.6% ± 6.5；pass@3 则升至 65.5% strict 与 70.3% flexible（Table 2 与 Figure 4）。这些结果说明 multi-turn retrieval 与 execution path 存在实质差异，也意味着 replay 需要 run ID、seed、documentation snapshot、model snapshot、cache state 与完整 trajectory；这些 artifact 均未发布。

在 130 个带 URL-level retrieval label 的 test repository 上，使用 GPT-4o 的 OSS-Build-Agent retriever 有 73.8% 访问到 ground-truth documentation URL，而 CompileAgent 为 46.2%（Section 6.2）。这是针对 labeled URL 的 navigation predicate，不能证明 retrieved content 正确、稳定、充分或 license-compatible。论文报告 OSS-Build-Agent 有 6.6 次 error-resolution attempt、CompileAgent 有 7.5 个 step，但后者一次只执行一条 command，不能把两者当作相同 efficiency unit。

failure analysis 给出一项 negative result：在检查的 o3-mini plus retrieval condition 中，有 69 个 repository 的 error 被 agent 识别，却在终止前始终没有修复（Section 6.3 与 Figure 5）。Appendix 案例包括从错误目录调用 CMake，以及没有先处理 root-cause submodule ownership error 就继续面对 downstream make install failure。这些案例支持 diagnosis 与 recovery 具有 brittleness，但完整逐 run log 未发布，无法独立重新编码核验。

当前 official data artifact 提供了超出论文的 release evidence：385 个 candidate label 保留 148 个 positive 与 237 个 negative，test label 现在固定全部 385 个 source commit，validation release 有 70 条记录，retrieval JSON 有 130 条记录。但 237 个 negative test row 中只有 126 个含非空 failure reason，而且这些 repository label 都不是 failed agent rollout。以上 performance value 均为作者报告，本 Card 未独立复现。benchmark performance 只能说明 system 在这套 benchmark contract 下的表现，不能证明 data release 对训练而言完整、无污染、安全或高质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is repository-compilation evaluation represented by the 100-project CompileAgentBench and the CompileAgent scaffold. Containers, shell-command execution, compiler-error feedback, web/document retrieval, retry loops, and target checks are established components; BuildBench does not make any one of them a new verifier class or training algorithm.

What changes is the benchmark construction and the visibility of its terminal contract. The authors start from millions of C/C++ GitHub repositories, apply explicit automated filters, randomly sample 385 candidates, and have experienced systems graduate students attempt every build. The 148 compilable tasks are paired with expert target-executable names. Agent behavior is evaluated through a fresh container, optional README/web retrieval, iterative command batches, and three nested outcome measures: unvalidated Completion, all-target Strict Success, and any-target Flexible Success.

The current release also preserves the complete 385-candidate compilability label pool rather than exposing only the 148 positive evaluation tasks. This makes some selection failures inspectable, although failure reasons are populated for only 126 of 237 negatives and no successful or failed agent rollouts are published. The later addition of source commit hashes for all test rows improves task pinning but is release maintenance, not a paper-time methodological contribution.

For environment-agent data research, the useful direction signal is to treat a repository benchmark as a tuple of pinned task source, resettable environment, action/observation protocol, allowed mutation policy, and terminal predicate. BuildBench makes most of that tuple conceptually explicit and shows why “the process finished” is weaker than target-aware verification. The filename predicate still stops short of functional tests, semantic equivalence, or security checks.

Quality should therefore be inferred from the specificity of the task labels, human construction, retained candidate failures, and explicit metrics—not from the best model score. Before reuse, an evaluator must inspect instance overlap with CompileAgentBench and other repository benchmarks, model-corpus contamination, target-label errors, functional behavior of binaries, allowed source changes, environment/dependency locks, full failure retention, release-version mapping, licenses, and sandbox security.

prior-work baseline 是以 100-project CompileAgentBench 与 CompileAgent scaffold 为代表的 repository-compilation evaluation。container、shell-command execution、compiler-error feedback、web/document retrieval、retry loop 与 target check 都是既有组件；BuildBench 没有把其中任何一项变成新的 verifier class 或 training algorithm。

真正改变的是 benchmark construction 与 terminal contract 的可见度。作者从数百万 C/C++ GitHub repository 出发，采用明确的 automated filter，随机抽取 385 个 candidate，并由有 systems 背景的研究生逐个尝试 build。148 个可编译 task 与人工 target-executable name 配对。agent behavior 通过全新 container、可选 README/web retrieval、iterative command batch，以及三层 outcome measure 评估：unvalidated Completion、要求所有 target 的 Strict Success，以及要求至少一个 target 的 Flexible Success。

当前 release 还保留完整的 385-candidate compilability label pool，而非只暴露 148 个 positive evaluation task。这样可以检查一部分 selection failure，但 237 个 negative 中只有 126 个有 failure reason，successful/failed agent rollout 则完全没有公开。后来为所有 test row 增加 source commit hash 改善了 task pinning，但这是 release maintenance，不是 paper-time methodological contribution。

对 environment-agent data 研究而言，有用的方向信号是把 repository benchmark 视为 pinned task source、resettable environment、action/observation protocol、allowed mutation policy 与 terminal predicate 的组合。BuildBench 在概念上明确了其中大部分，也说明“process finished”弱于 target-aware verification；filename predicate 仍不能替代 functional test、semantic equivalence 或 security check。

因此，quality signal 应来自 task label 的具体性、人工构造、保留的 candidate failure 与明确 metric，而不是最高 model score。复用前必须检查与 CompileAgentBench 及其他 repository benchmark 的 instance overlap、model-corpus contamination、target-label error、binary functional behavior、allowed source change、environment/dependency lock、完整 failure retention、release-version mapping、license 与 sandbox security。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Verifier false positives and false negatives. Unvalidated Completion can count intermediate binaries left by a failed build or a successfully built submodule/vendored package. Strict/Flexible Success improves target awareness but matches filenames, not function, runtime behavior, semantic fidelity, provenance, or security. A stale or incorrect artifact with an expected name can be a false positive; a correct executable with a different name can be a false negative. The online Success(f_k) implementation and numeric K are unknown.
  • Source mutation changes the object being judged. The scaffold permits source edits, and the paper demonstrates an OpenCV API patch. No allowed-change policy, patch diff requirement, semantic-equivalence test, or separation between “build original source” and “repair then build” is disclosed. A successful filename predicate may therefore describe a modified program whose intended behavior was never checked.
  • Environment and replay are under-specified. “Fresh Ubuntu 22.04 container” does not pin a Dockerfile/image digest, preinstalled packages, compiler and dependency versions, package-index snapshot, submodule policy, network allowlist, retrieved-page snapshot, cache state, wall-clock timeout, numeric K, model/API snapshot, seeds, or replay command. Live web pages and mutable dependency services can change both observations and outcomes. No public paper-linked OSS-Build-Agent or evaluator implementation was verified.
  • The release is not a rollout corpus. The current test data preserve 148 positive and 237 negative repository labels, but only 126 negatives contain a failure reason. Complete successful and failed command-observation trajectories, stdout/stderr, patches, artifacts, retry histories, and per-run terminal outcomes are absent. The 130-record retrieval file and “Build Trajectory” column contain URL chains, not shell commands or environment observations.
  • Paper-time to current schema drift is not mapped. The paper-time test label commit d0a2dfa8a309897f7bb299eb4fff067a58442d06 had six fields and no source commits. Current test revision 3c3fcb66ddd525219857a40c91d94a8b32c59e14 adds failure metadata, commit_hash, and retrieval_labels.json; no paper-linked tag or changelog explains the migration. Validation revision 971b6834230b5cbc4695d42bddc5ff51cf1267c8 still lacks source commit hashes.
  • Overlap and contamination remain open. Fork removal does not detect copied, vendored, renamed, or code-clone overlap. No instance-level deduplication against CompileAgentBench or other repository-agent benchmarks is reported, and there is no audit of whether evaluated model pretraining contained repositories, READMEs, documentation, fixes, or target names. The 2024 source cutoff and star/keyword filters are not decontamination evidence.
  • Licensing is layered and incomplete. Both Hugging Face dataset cards declare CC BY 4.0, but this does not supersede rights in linked repositories, dependencies, documentation, generated patches, or binaries. At the pinned revisions, 92 of 385 test license cells are blank, 60 are NOASSERTION, and 18 of 70 validation licenses are NOASSERTION. No end-to-end attribution/rights manifest is released.
  • Execution has a serious security boundary. The disclosed agent runs untrusted repositories and build scripts as root, installs packages, follows external URLs, and may edit source. The paper reports no threat model, egress restriction, sandbox-hardening profile, secret policy, supply-chain isolation, or artifact malware scan. Reuse in a privileged or networked host would be unsafe; this is a curator inference from the disclosed execution surface.
  • Scope and use are limited. The benchmark covers sampled GitHub C/C++ repositories meeting the filters and evaluates compilation under filename predicates. It does not establish general software-engineering capability, runtime correctness, portability, maintainability, or security. Benchmark gains are not evidence of data quality or training utility, and the paper supports evaluation and audit only.

• Verifier 的 false positive 与 false negative。 unvalidated Completion 可能把失败 build 留下的 intermediate binary，或成功 build 的 submodule/vendored package 计为完成。Strict/Flexible Success 虽然提高 target awareness，却只匹配 filename，不检查 function、runtime behavior、semantic fidelity、provenance 或 security。带预期名称的 stale/incorrect artifact 可能成为 false positive，名称不同但正确的 executable 可能成为 false negative。online Success(f_k) 的实现与 K 数值均为 unknown。
  • Source mutation 改变了被评判对象。 scaffold 允许修改 source，论文也展示了 OpenCV API patch。作者没有披露 allowed-change policy、patch diff 要求、semantic-equivalence test，也没有区分“build original source”和“repair then build”。因此 filename predicate 成功可能只说明修改后的程序生成了目标名称，其 intended behavior 从未被检查。
  • Environment 与 replay 规格不足。 “全新 Ubuntu 22.04 container”没有固定 Dockerfile/image digest、预装 package、compiler/dependency version、package-index snapshot、submodule policy、network allowlist、retrieved-page snapshot、cache state、wall-clock timeout、K 数值、model/API snapshot、seed 或 replay command。live web page 与可变 dependency service 会同时改变 observation 与 outcome。没有核验到公开且与论文关联的 OSS-Build-Agent 或 evaluator implementation。
  • Release 不是 rollout corpus。 当前 test data 保留 148 个 positive 与 237 个 negative repository label，但只有 126 个 negative 含 failure reason。完整 successful/failed command-observation trajectory、stdout/stderr、patch、artifact、retry history 与逐 run terminal outcome 均缺失。130-record retrieval file 与“Build Trajectory”列包含 URL chain，而非 shell command 或 environment observation。
  • Paper-time 到 current schema 的 drift 没有映射。 paper-time test label commit d0a2dfa8a309897f7bb299eb4fff067a58442d06 只有 6 个字段且没有 source commit。当前 test revision 3c3fcb66ddd525219857a40c91d94a8b32c59e14 新增 failure metadata、commit_hash 与 retrieval_labels.json；没有与论文关联的 tag 或 changelog 解释迁移。validation revision 971b6834230b5cbc4695d42bddc5ff51cf1267c8 仍缺 source commit hash。
  • Overlap 与 contamination 仍未解决。 去除 fork 不能发现 copied、vendored、renamed 或 code-clone overlap。论文没有报告与 CompileAgentBench 或其他 repository-agent benchmark 的 instance-level deduplication，也没有审计 evaluated model 的 pretraining 是否包含这些 repository、README、documentation、fix 或 target name。2024 source cutoff 与 star/keyword filter 不是 decontamination evidence。
  • License 分层且不完整。 两个 Hugging Face dataset card 都声明 CC BY 4.0，但这不能覆盖 linked repository、dependency、documentation、generated patch 或 binary 的权利。在固定 revision 中，385 个 test license cell 有 92 个空白、60 个为 NOASSERTION；70 个 validation license 有 18 个为 NOASSERTION。没有 end-to-end attribution/rights manifest。
  • Execution 存在严重 security 边界。 论文披露的 agent 以 root 运行不可信 repository 与 build script，安装 package、访问 external URL，并可能修改 source。论文没有报告 threat model、egress restriction、sandbox-hardening profile、secret policy、supply-chain isolation 或 artifact malware scan。根据这一 execution surface，curator inference 是：不能在 privileged 或普通 networked host 上直接复用。
  • 范围与用途有限。 benchmark 只覆盖满足 filter 的 GitHub C/C++ repository，并以 filename predicate 评测 compilation；不能据此证明一般 software-engineering capability、runtime correctness、portability、maintainability 或 security。benchmark gain 不是 data quality 或 training utility 的证据，论文只支持 evaluation 与 audit。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, BuildBench is useful as an evaluation design and audit case, not as a trajectory-training corpus. It shows how to represent a repository task separately from an execution episode: pin the source commit and target filenames; record the initial container and retrieved context; capture each command batch, stdout/stderr observation, filesystem delta, dependency/network event, patch, produced artifact, and terminal verdict; then distinguish completion from target-aware success.

Researchers can use the benchmark to compare documentation retrieval, command batching, diagnosis/retry policies, dependency handling, and source-repair behavior under a reconstructed environment. Useful controlled studies include replacing filename checks with executable smoke/functional tests, scoring original-source builds separately from patched builds, measuring sensitivity to package/document snapshots, and estimating false-positive/false-negative rates for Completion, Strict Success, Flexible Success, and the undisclosed online stopping rule.

The construction record is also an audit recipe. A future repository-agent benchmark can publish the full 385-candidate decision ledger, annotator protocol and adjudication, all positive and negative build attempts, target-label evidence, code-clone overlap results, model-corpus exposure checks, and item-level license lineage. BuildBench's 148-positive/237-negative current label pool, 70-row validation set, 130 retrieval labels, and schema drift provide concrete checks for whether task counts, splits, failure retention, and release versions remain aligned.

Any evaluation reuse should pin test revision 3c3fcb66ddd525219857a40c91d94a8b32c59e14, validation revision 971b6834230b5cbc4695d42bddc5ff51cf1267c8, and the per-test repository commits; provide a locked, disposable, non-privileged, network-restricted container; snapshot dependencies and documentation; record cache, timeout, K, model versions, seeds, all command/observation logs, patches, and binaries; and run functional and security checks beyond filenames. Validation repositories still need source commits.

The safe reuse class is evaluation and audit only. The paper does not support using the released rows as SFT demonstrations, preference pairs, process labels, reward-model examples, RLVR rewards, or agent-policy rollouts. Training reuse is blocked by the absence of full trajectories, evaluator/scaffold code, fixed environments, failure logs, overlap/decontamination evidence, complete licenses, and a safe execution policy.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，BuildBench 适合作为 evaluation design 与 audit case，而不是 trajectory-training corpus。它展示了如何把 repository task 与 execution episode 分开表示：固定 source commit 与 target filename；记录 initial container 与 retrieved context；捕获每一批 command、stdout/stderr observation、filesystem delta、dependency/network event、patch、produced artifact 与 terminal verdict；最后区分 completion 与 target-aware success。

研究者可以在重建的 environment 中比较 documentation retrieval、command batching、diagnosis/retry policy、dependency handling 与 source-repair behavior。可执行的 controlled study 包括：用 executable smoke/functional test 替换 filename check，分别评分 original-source build 与 patched build，测量 package/document snapshot sensitivity，并估计 Completion、Strict Success、Flexible Success 与未披露 online stopping rule 的 false-positive/false-negative rate。

construction record 也可作为 audit recipe。未来的 repository-agent benchmark 可以公开完整 385-candidate decision ledger、annotator protocol 与 adjudication、全部 positive/negative build attempt、target-label evidence、code-clone overlap result、model-corpus exposure check 与逐条 license lineage。BuildBench 当前 148-positive/237-negative label pool、70-row validation set、130 个 retrieval label 与 schema drift，为检查 task count、split、failure retention 与 release version 是否对齐提供了具体案例。

任何 evaluation reuse 都应固定 test revision 3c3fcb66ddd525219857a40c91d94a8b32c59e14、validation revision 971b6834230b5cbc4695d42bddc5ff51cf1267c8 与每个 test repository commit；使用 locked、disposable、non-privileged、network-restricted container；snapshot dependency 与 documentation；记录 cache、timeout、K、model version、seed、全部 command/observation log、patch 与 binary；并执行超出 filename 的 functional/security check。validation repository 仍需补充 source commit。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit。论文不支持把公开记录用作 SFT demonstration、preference pair、process label、reward-model example、RLVR reward 或 agent-policy rollout。缺少完整 trajectory、evaluator/scaffold code、固定 environment、failure log、overlap/decontamination evidence、完整 license 与安全 execution policy，使 training reuse 处于 blocked 状态。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with the released object, not the best score: the current test revision has 385 candidate labels—148 compilable and 237 non-compilable—plus 130 retrieval-label records; the separate validation revision has 70 rows. Agent evaluation in the paper uses the 148 positives.
  • Do not interpret “Build Trajectory” as an agent rollout. It is a documentation-URL chain. Commands, execution observations, patches, binaries, retries, and per-run verdicts are not publicly released.
  • Keep the feedback contract exact: Completion means error-free termination plus at least one binary; Strict Success requires every expert target filename; Flexible Success requires at least one. None verifies binary functionality, semantic fidelity, or security, and online Success(f_k)/K are undisclosed.
  • Read Section 2 for sampling/manual construction, Sections 3.1–3.2 for retrieval and the execution loop, Section 5 for predicates, Tables 1–2/Figure 4 for model and variance evidence, and Section 6.3 plus Appendices D–F for failures and source modification. Scores do not prove data quality.
  • Before reuse, reconcile paper-time commit d0a2dfa8a309897f7bb299eb4fff067a58442d06 with current test 3c3fcb66ddd525219857a40c91d94a8b32c59e14 and validation 971b6834230b5cbc4695d42bddc5ff51cf1267c8; then audit environment locks, overlap/decontamination, layered licenses, failure retention, and root/network execution security.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Unvalidated completion can be a false positive when a failed build leaves intermediate binaries or only a submodule/vendored package builds.
Strict/flexible filename matching does not establish binary functionality, semantic fidelity, security, or reproducibility and can be fooled by wrong or stale artifacts with expected names.
Online Success(f_k), numerical K, and the evaluator implementation are undisclosed; an agent may terminate before resolving root causes.
Agents can patch source code, so build success may refer to a modified program without a semantic-equivalence or allowed-change check.
LLM retrieval may follow different live-documentation paths, and model nondeterminism compounds over multi-turn execution.

Dependency resolution, wrong directories, incorrect flags, repository errors, and insufficient troubleshooting are documented failure modes; 69 inspected o3-mini cases recognized errors but failed to resolve them.
未验证完成在失败构建留下中间二进制或仅子模块/vendored 包构建时可能是假阳性。
严格/灵活文件名匹配并不确立二进制功能性、语义保真、安全性或可复现性，且可能被带有预期名称的错误或过时产物愚弄。
在线 Success(f_k)、数值 K 与评测器实现未披露；智能体可能在解决根因前终止。
智能体可修补源代码，因此构建成功可能指被修改的程序，而无语义等价或允许变更检查。
LLM 检索可能跟随不同的实时文档路径，且模型非确定性在多轮执行中叠加。
依赖解析、错误目录、不正确 flags、仓库错误与故障排查不足是已记录的失败模式；69 个受检 o3-mini 案例识别了错误但未能解决。
